sustainability.title: Our Commitment to Sustainability
sustainability.subtitle: We create high-quality wooden products while minimizing our environmental impact through ethical, thoughtful practices that balance tradition with responsibility.
sustainability.wasteReductionDesc: We minimize environmental impact by maximizing material efficiency in every step of our process.
sustainability.responsibleSourcingDesc: We work directly with communities to ensure ethical harvesting practices that respect both nature and tradition.
sustainability.communityEducationDesc: Education is key to lasting change. We invest in training and awareness programs throughout our supply chain.
sustainability.peoplePlanetDesc: True sustainability means protecting both our environment and empowering the people who create our products.
sustainability.balancingDesc: While some of the wood we use is slow-growing hardwood, we take conscious steps to reduce harm and promote long-term sustainability. Our handcrafted chessboards and wooden products are made using ethical practices that honor both our craft traditions and our planet.
sustainability.impactDesc: We believe that true sustainability is about protecting the environment and empowering people. Every purchase supports ethical craftsmanship, rural livelihoods, and a growing movement toward conscious, meaningful design.
sustainability.wasteReductionPoint1: Using wood offcuts and reclaimed timber whenever possible
sustainability.wasteReductionPoint2: Repurposing leftover materials to reduce waste
sustainability.wasteReductionPoint3: Training artisans in minimal waste production techniques
sustainability.responsibleSourcingPoint1: Partnering with communities who own trees
sustainability.ourImpactDesc: Every purchase supports ethical craftsmanship, rural livelihoods, and conscious design

csr.title: Empowering Communities, Transforming Lives
csr.subtitle: Our commitment goes beyond creating beautiful crafts. We're building stronger communities, empowering artisans, and creating lasting positive change across Africa.
csr.fairTradeDesc: We believe in fair compensation and ethical treatment of all our artisans. Our commitment to fair trade principles ensures that traditional craftspeople receive fair wages and work in safe, respectful conditions.
csr.partnerWithUs: Partner with Us for Social Impact
csr.partnerDesc: Every purchase you make contributes to our social impact programs. Join us in creating sustainable livelihoods, empowering communities, and preserving African cultural heritage for future generations.

successStory.title: Success Story: Mary's Cooperative
successStory.description: In 2018, we supported Mary Banda in forming a women's basketry cooperative in rural Malawi. Starting with just 5 women, the cooperative now employs 25 female artisans, has built a community workshop, and provides healthcare benefits to all members' families. Mary's story represents the transformative power of ethical business practices and community-centered development.

returnPolicy.title: Return & Refund Policy
returnPolicy.subtitle: We want you to be completely happy with your purchase. If for any reason you're not satisfied, we're here to help.
returnPolicy.customerServiceDesc: Our customer service team is here to assist you with returns, refunds, or any questions about your purchase.
returnPolicy.policyNotice: This policy applies to all orders placed through our website. For orders placed through third-party platforms, please refer to their respective return policies. We reserve the right to update this policy at any time, with changes taking effect immediately upon posting.
returnPolicy.returnDescription: You may return an item within 14 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange, provided the item:
returnPolicy.originalCondition: Is in its original condition (unused and undamaged)
returnPolicy.originalPackaging: Is returned in its original packaging
returnPolicy.notCustomItem: Is not a custom or personalized item (unless damaged or defective)
returnPolicy.emailInstructions: Email us at [your email] with your order number and reason for return. We'll provide instructions for shipping the item back to us.
returnPolicy.refundDescription: Once we receive and inspect your returned item, we'll notify you and process your refund to your original payment method within 5–7 business days.
returnPolicy.customItemException: Custom-made or personalized items cannot be returned or refunded, unless they arrive damaged or with a manufacturing fault.
returnPolicy.shippingCostException: Return shipping costs are the buyer's responsibility unless the item is incorrect or arrives damaged.
returnPolicy.damagedDescription: If your item arrives damaged or is not what you ordered, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery, with clear photos. We'll arrange a replacement or refund at no extra cost to you.
returnPolicy.reportWithPhotos: Report issues within 48 hours with photos for fastest resolution
